decisions.why: Shear comfort knee plate protector, foot plate protector, elbow protectors, and arm support protectors span upper limb (elbow, arm) and lower limb (knee, foot) orthotic supports
Hygienio disinfection system and Hygienio C4 represent general disinfection (cssd); Vaciopak and Vaciopak for Endoscopy are specifically endoscopy decontamination (endo)
